value.rationale: This is a complete natural phase diagram for a physically motivated transient observable: renewal regularity causes exponentially damped alternating overshoots that cannot be inferred from the stationary variance alone. The threshold compares the reset clock spectral gap to OU confinement, and its shape-three boundary is nontrivial. Explicit leading damping, frequency and nonzero amplitude predict detectability limits and provide a testable signature of non-Poisson renewal memory.
